description: This script analyzes skipped Dynamo tests, generates a histogram of failure reasons, and provides repro commands. It processes test result XMLs, normalizes skip messages, and formats output for reporting or GitHub issues.

methods.name: skip_reason
methods.description: Extracts the skip message from a test case XML element.

methods.name: skip_reason_normalized
methods.description: Normalizes the skip message by masking variable parts for comparison.

methods.name: get_failures
methods.description: Aggregates test cases by normalized skip reason, returning sorted failure info.

methods.name: repro
methods.description: Constructs a pytest command to reproduce a specific test case.

methods.name: all_tests
methods.description: Generates a string identifier for a test case.

methods.name: failures_histogram
methods.description: Generates and prints a histogram of test failures with optional verbose and formatting.

methods.name: as_issue
methods.description: Formats failure data into a markdown string suitable for GitHub issues.
